        completionTokens     INT NULL,
        totalTokens          INT NULL,
        costUSD              DECIMAL(10,2) NULL,
        modelName            NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
        timestamp            DATETIME NULL,
        created_At           DATETIME NULL,
        updated_at           DATETIME NULL
    );

    INSERT INTO @payload (
        factoryRunUsageId,
        factoryRunRef,
        promptTokens,
        completionTokens,
        totalTokens,
        costUSD,
        modelName,
        timestamp,
        created_At,
        updated_at
    )
    SELECT
        TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.factoryRunUsageId')),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.factoryRunRef'),
        TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.promptTokens')),
        TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.completionTokens')),
        TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.totalTokens')),
        TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(10,2), JSON_VALUE(value, '$.costUSD')),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.modelName'),
        TRY_CONVERT(DATETIME, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.timestamp')),
        TRY_CONVERT(DATETIME, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.created_At')),
        TRY_CONVERT(DATETIME, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.updated_at'))
    FROM OPENJSON(@pjsonfile, '$.factoryRunUsages');

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        IF @action = 1 -- INSERT
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO dbo.FactoryRunUsages (
                factoryRunRef,
                promptTokens,
                completionTokens,
                totalTokens,
                costUSD,
                modelName,
                timestamp,
                created_At,
                updated_at
            )
            SELECT
                p.factoryRunRef,
                p.promptTokens,
                p.completionTokens,
                p.totalTokens,
                p.costUSD,
                p.modelName,
                p.timestamp,
                ISNULL(p.created_At, GETDATE()),
                p.updated_at
            FROM @payload AS p;
        END
        ELSE IF @action = 2 -- UPDATE
        BEGIN
            UPDATE fru
            SET
                factoryRunRef = p.factoryRunRef,
                promptTokens = p.promptTokens,
                completionTokens = p.completionTokens,
                totalTokens = p.totalTokens,
                costUSD = p.costUSD,
                modelName = p.modelName,
                timestamp = p.timestamp,
                updated_at = GETDATE()
            FROM dbo.FactoryRunUsages AS fru
            INNER JOIN @payload AS p
                ON fru.factoryRunUsageId = p.factoryRunUsageId;
        END
        ELSE IF @action = 3 -- DELETE
        BEGIN
            DELETE fru
            FROM dbo.FactoryRunUsages AS fru
            INNER JOIN @payload AS p
                ON fru.factoryRunUsageId = p.factoryRunUsageId;
        END

        SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Inserted/Updated/Deleted Successfully');
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;

        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
